T: The island is erupting. The oven is on.
D: Owen and Claire go back to Isla Nublar to rescue the dinosaurs before a volcano wipes them out.
P: Serve dessert when the volcano blows on Isla Nublar.
S: Owen building his cabin by hand
Thick beef sausages grilled over coals, sliced and served on toothpicks with mustard and caramelised onion.
the auction at the Lockwood mansion
Smoked salmon on rye with crème fraîche and dill, and prosciutto wrapped around melon, served on silver trays.
the secret cloning lab under Lockwood Manor
Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in sausage meat, crumbed and cooked golden, then halved like cracked dinosaur eggs.
M: Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare with a red wine sauce, potato gratin and green beans, served as if for the auction guests.
the rescue team heading into the jungle
Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic and chilli, grilled until charred, with rice and black beans.
W: Owen's cabin before the island trip
Bananas split in their skins, stuffed with chocolate and marshmallow and baked in foil. Slit 4 bananas along one side, open slightly and stuff with 100g chopped chocolate and 50g mini marshmallows.
K: Lemonade with a dash of blue colouring and lime juice over crushed ice.

s.note: Owen building his cabin by hand
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly with a spoon of brown sugar for 30 minutes until jammy. Grill 8 thick beef sausages over coals until blistered and cooked through. Slice thickly, spear on toothpicks and serve with the onions and wholegrain mustard.

s.note: the secret cloning lab under Lockwood Manor
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Wrap each in about 80g sausage meat, 500g in total, roll in flour, 1 beaten egg and breadcrumbs. Deep fry at 170C for 6 minutes, or bake at 200C for 25 minutes, then halve to serve.

m.note: the rescue team heading into the jungle
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in lime juice, crushed garlic, chopped red chilli and salt for an hour. Grill until charred and cooked through. Serve with steamed long grain rice and a can of black beans warmed with a little cumin.

w.note: Owen's cabin before the island trip
w.how: Slit 4 bananas along one side, open slightly and stuff with 100g chopped chocolate and 50g mini marshmallows. Wrap in foil and bake on the coals or at 200C for 10 minutes.

d.how: Fill glasses with crushed ice. Pour in cold lemonade and add a drop of blue food colouring to each, stirring until bright blue. Squeeze in a wedge of lime and serve straight away. Name it after the cleverest raptor on the island.
